summary: Potential directions and exploration become one loop. The local English phrase mining (branch_candidates) is removed. When the reader collects (useful / understood) a paper that was shown in an exploration slot, it waits to be judged; one explicit click (learning-map page or a prompt on the Today card) sends at most three such papers (title and abstract excerpt, p1..p3, no ids), the map's concept names and the directions already on file to the new budgeted operation direction_judge. The reply is an opinion (new / join / covered / unclear) that is validated locally (needs must be existing concepts; a 'new' that repeats words on the map or reads like a concept of the map, cosine >= T_NEAR, becomes covered) and stored per project; the app only counts the evidence under each direction (papers, still-marked papers, sources, strength). The learning-map page lists the stored directions and draws a direction (ghost node, progress outline, arrows, topology) only after the row is clicked; adding needs all four gates and the click, and uses the model's Chinese name, English search terms, intro + barrier (intro_by ai) and prerequisites. Exploration slots prefer pool papers that read like a stored direction's papers (explore_new). concept_intro now also sends up to three matching project papers (title, abstract excerpt) so the intro says what the concept means in those papers and what makes it hard; INTRO_LIMIT 90 -> 140; the edit box keeps the matched-papers block.

budget_impact.rationale: Reading directions, counting evidence, pending lists, exploration steering and the ghost preview are local and deterministic: zero tokens. Model-facing changes, both approved by the owner on 2026-10-06 (AskUserQuestion answer: 批准：简介 + 方向解释两项上调): concept_intro input cap 500->2000 and output cap 250->400 (20 attempts per project per local day unchanged) because it now also sends up to three matching project papers (title <=80 chars, abstract first 200 chars); new operation direction_judge, input cap 3000, output cap 500, 10 attempts per project per local day (App.DIRECTION_JUDGES_PER_DAY, in code), one explicit click, up to three collected exploration papers (title <=80, abstract first 180 chars, p1..p3 without ids), up to ten concept names and up to three stored directions. Worst cases by the 1.5 tokens-per-character heuristic: about 1950 and 2930 input tokens. The abstract excerpts are 200/180 characters, shorter than the 250 the owner was shown, to stay under the caps. Neither prompt has had a real call.

open_risks: direction_judge and the paper-grounded concept_intro prompts have never had a real model call: JSON compliance, the quality of 'clearly different from the map' and of the barrier text are unknown.
T_NEAR (0.40), T_TOWARD (0.20) and the strength gate are named constants without data.

Growth is slower and needs AI: a direction only exists after the reader collected exploration papers and asked the AI; papers the reader found elsewhere never trigger it; offline no new direction appears (stored ones stay visible).
A judged-but-unclear paper is not asked about again (no way to re-ask in the UI).
Directions found by the previous phrase mining are gone; they were never stored.
Not merged with main: the other session's 'understood needs a saved paper' rule may break fixtures that mark unsaved papers understood.
The Tauri window was not clicked through.
The local near-check (T_NEAR) is weak for a concept that has few matching papers, so a neighbour can still be called new; the reader can turn it down.
